title: Vote: adopt the expressions spec
summary: These are the closing messages of the vote to adopt the expressions spec; the message that called the vote is not part of this set. Fokko and Eduard Tudenhöfner cast binding +1 votes, and Neelesh Salian and Huang-Hsiang Cheng cast non-binding +1 votes. On June 30th Ryan Blue, noting that he had replied from the wrong account the day before, announced the result: the vote passes with 30 +1 votes, of which 13 are binding, and no -1 or +0 votes. He thanked everyone for reviewing.

outcome.note: The vote passed with 30 +1 votes, 13 of them binding, and no -1 or +0 votes.

why_it_matters: The expressions spec is adopted by vote.
